verdict.rationale: Calendly documents an official Calendly MCP server. It turns natural-language commands into structured Calendly API calls, uses Dynamic Client Registration so no pre-registered OAuth app is needed, and publishes a complete tool list mapped to REST endpoints; a probe confirms the official MCP docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting to the MCP server in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Bring scheduling actions into your AI apps through natural conversation, powered by Calendly MCP.
Calendly MCP uses Dynamic Client Registration (DCR), which means **you do not need to pre-register an OAuth application**
